title: End of Summer Networking
description: Utah Agile Join us at Olympic Park in Lehi to close out the summer and open up connections and possibilities. It's been a few months since we last met, so we look forward to reengaging with as many as can make it.  Much is changing, so what a great opportunity to have casual conversations to learn and share what's happening all around us.  Come enjoy some light dinner (maybe even some grilled goodies), bring a friend (even the four-legged kind), and reconnect with others who are "doing it and helping others do it," to improve the world of work and achieve better outcomes.  And if you're so inclined, feel free to bring a treat or side to share. The more the merrier.  If you still haven't joined us for a Utah Agile event in the past, this is a great way to get to know us and learn more about what's possible.
